Bug_Title: Se: Method must be private in order for serialization to work (SE_METHOD_MUST_BE_PRIVATE)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is that the writeObject method in the SerializationBug class is not declared as private, which is required for serialization to work correctly. As a result, the serialization mechanism will ignore this method, failing to write the uppercase version of the data in the object.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered because the 'writeObject' method in the SerializationBug class is not declared private. This causes the serialization/deserialization API to ignore this method, leading to incorrect deserialization of the 'data' field.
